title: Clutch Pedal Position (CPP) Switch
introduction: The clutch-pedal-position switch lives beside the pedal in the driver’s footwell. I use its upward-pointing plunger and bottom electrical connection to identify it before starting; footwell yoga is awkward enough without wrestling the wrong part. This is removal and refitting of the switch in the stated engine application, not an adjustment or an electrical fault-isolation test.

items.name: Stationary footwell access
items.detail: Park the car with the parking brake applied. Work from the driver’s footwell, looking upward beside the clutch pedal arm. Identify the small switch on its bracket with the slender plunger upward and electrical plug below. Keep the footwell clear of loose tools before returning the vehicle to use.

items.name: Match the application
items.detail: Use this reference for the stated Duratec engine application, with the clutch pedal switch and its bracket accessible.

items.name: Read both sections first
items.detail: Review removal and installation before starting because the removal instructions may contain installation details.

items.name: Resolve attachment releases
items.detail: Confirm the electrical connector's latch release and the switch mounting-retainer release before removal. The supplied text and image do not establish their precise movements.

items.name: Review the applicable safety references
items.detail: Before starting, review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189) and its required clutch-system referral, [Brake and Clutch Systems Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693183).

items.name: Prevent unintended starting
items.detail: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person starting the engine during service; accidental starting may cause serious personal injury. Before service underneath or around the vehicle, disable remote start, if equipped, using the Central Display under Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Unexpected remote starting could cause personal injury or death.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling pointed or sharp-edged parts around the mounting area. Failure to use the required protection may result in serious personal injury.

edits.text: NOTE: The removal instructions may also include details needed for installation.
edits.why: Reviewing removal and refitting together helps keep each attachment's installation detail in context.

edits.text: Disconnect the electrical connector at the lower end of the CPP switch, then remove the switch from its bracket. In the inset, the switch withdraws sideways away from the bracket, toward the left of that view.
edits.why:
Support the plug body, release its locking engagement and unplug it from the bottom of the switch. Pull on the housing rather than its wires, then move the plug and attached wiring clear of the switch’s path. Leave the rest of the harness installed.

Note the plunger-up and plug-down orientation. Release the retaining engagement where the side of the switch meets the bracket, then withdraw the body sideways away from the bracket as the inset shows. Handle the body rather than the slender plunger. If it remains caught, inspect the engagement rather than forcing it; the illustration does not establish a universal push-or-twist unlatching motion.

edits.text: Install in reverse removal order: refit the CPP switch into its bracket by reversing the withdrawal movement, then reconnect the electrical connector.
edits.why: Orient the switch as removed, align its mounting features and seat its retaining engagement fully in the bracket. Confirm that the bracket holds it before reconnecting the wiring. Reconnect the plug by its housing and secure its locking engagement. Check the bracket retention and plug connection separately, and keep the wiring clear of the pedal’s moving parts. Remove loose tools from the footwell. These checks confirm that the switch is refitted securely; electrical diagnosis and adjustment require their own procedures.

readerOutcome: Locate the illustrated switch attachments and understand disconnection, withdrawal and reverse refitting order while recognizing the unresolved access and release prerequisites.
teachingNotes: Active editor independently viewed original E184950 and reconciled same-source independently reviewed practical job-2c89743db16dc16f. Source shows lateral separation, does not justify invented push/twist release. Fresh reviewer must independently assess full source and figure, not accept counterpart authority blindly.

operationalClarification.scope: Stationary ground-level footwell access and mechanical assembly check only; no new isolation,adjustment,diagnosis or trim teardown.
